description: 4ndr0neering v8.3.0 System One decision-boundary contract (DB-001..DB-012) for advisory contributor PR & suite triage on 4ndr0666/userscripts. Final merge acceptance remains deterministically enforced by contract.json and npm run check.

questions.prompt: Does `pr_diff_summary` edit generated `dist/` userscripts without corresponding upstream edits in `src/` or `kernel/`?
questions.true_criterion: The diff modifies one or more files in `dist/` while leaving matching `src/` and `kernel/` sources untouched.
questions.false_criterion: The diff edits upstream `src/`, `kernel/`, `tools/`, `tests/`, or `scripts/` sources (with or without regenerated `dist/` artifacts).

questions.prompt: Does `pr_diff_summary` modify shared runtime code inside `kernel/`?
questions.true_criterion: At least one of the 7 kernel modules (`brand.js`, `core.js`, `glass.js`, `hosts.js`, `hotkeys.js`, `net.js`, `store.js`) is modified.
questions.false_criterion: All changed files reside outside the `kernel/` directory.

questions.prompt: Does `pr_diff_summary` introduce a brand-new installable userscript in `src/`?
questions.true_criterion: A new `src/4ndr0tools - <Name>.user.js` file or new modular `src/<name>/meta.json` directory is added.
questions.false_criterion: The PR only updates existing scripts, tooling, tests, or documentation without adding a new installable.

questions.prompt: Which canonical `userscripts` suite family best matches the new script described in `pr_diff_summary`?

options.name: media_and_links
options.criterion: Link extraction, streaming, file hosts, or media-download utilities.

options.name: images
options.criterion: Image galleries, reverse image search, or image host enhancements.

options.name: video_and_players
options.criterion: Video player controls, filters, or video platform utilities.

options.name: forums
options.criterion: Forum navigation, thread extraction, confirmation bypass, or model search utilities.

options.name: privacy_and_security
options.criterion: Ad/tracker blocking, purge, service guard, recon, or paywall bypass utilities.

options.name: ux_utilities
options.criterion: General browser UX, windowing, translation, login autofill, HostWarp, or PageCraft utilities.

options.name: sovereign_platforms
options.criterion: AI/LLM platform suites and creative studio tools.

questions.prompt: What is the blast radius of the changes described in `pr_diff_summary`?

levels.name: low_cosmetic
levels.criterion: Documentation, comments, metadata wording, or isolated single-script CSS/UI tweaks.

levels.name: medium_single_script
levels.criterion: Behavioral logic change confined to one userscript in `src/` with no shared kernel or build changes.

levels.name: high_kernel_or_build
levels.criterion: Changes to `kernel/`, `tools/build.mjs`, `contract.json`, or cross-cutting security/OPSEC gates affecting all 39 installables.

rules.rationale: dist/ is a derived build artifact; edits must be ported into src/ or kernel/ and rebuilt via npm run check.
Bimodal score distribution indicates conflicting blast-radius signals; require human maintainer review.
Indeterminate Noul middle band routes fail-closed to maintainer review.
Kernel modifications affect all 16+ NetHook/modular consumers and require gh 4ndr0tools audit.
New installable requires FAMILIES registration in tools/inventory.mjs and architecture.installables bump in contract.json.
Routine src/ or tooling update governed by npm run check + npm test.
